name: FoodMaster Lite – Restaurant Food Ordering & Delivery for WooCommerce
author: WPSlash

sections.description:
FoodMaster Lite turns WooCommerce into an online ordering system for your restaurant. Customers browse your food menu, pick toppings and sizes, choose delivery or pickup and pay at checkout. Orders land in WooCommerce like any other order, and there’s no commission per order.

It suits pizzerias, takeaways, cafés, burger bars, bakeries, food trucks and any restaurant that wants to take orders on its own website instead of through a delivery app.

The setup wizard gets you started in minutes. Pick a restaurant type and it imports a complete demo: products with photos, extras groups, pages, a menu page, colours and opening hours. Then replace the demo content with your own.

Free features

Food menu and ordering

  • Accordion menu block: your WooCommerce products grouped by category in a fast, collapsible menu. Add it to any page with the “Accordion menu” block.
  • Add-to-cart popup: customers choose options and quantity in a popup and stay on the menu page.
  • Extras (product add-ons): toppings, sizes, crusts, sides and drinks, with single or multiple choice, minimum and maximum choices, required groups and extra prices. Assign a group to whole product categories or to single products.
  • Mini cart: a cart that follows the customer while they order.

Delivery and pickup

  • Delivery and pickup order types: customers choose at checkout. Set the default type and pause either one when the kitchen is busy.
  • Opening hours: weekly hours for delivery and pickup, with several time slots per day for lunch and dinner. Orders are only accepted while you’re open.
  • Delivery fee and minimum order: a fixed delivery fee and a minimum order amount.
  • Estimated times: show how long delivery or pickup usually takes.
  • WooCommerce block checkout: works with the Cart and Checkout blocks and the classic checkout. Compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

Restaurant website

  • Restaurant blocks: hero with an “Open now” status, opening hours, location and hours, category cards, ordering details and an “Open now” badge.
  • Block patterns: ready-made About, Contact, Delivery and pickup, Catering and FAQ sections.
  • Design styles: three storefront styles (Takeaway Flyer, Counter Display, Night Service) and colour schemes to match your brand.
  • Demo import: complete demos for pizzerias, Italian, burger, Asian and Mexican restaurants.

For every store

  • Mobile-first menu and checkout
  • Works with any well-coded theme, including block themes
  • Translation-ready and RTL-ready
  • Built on WooCommerce, so you keep its payments, taxes, emails and reports

How it works

  1. Install and activate WooCommerce and FoodMaster Lite.
  2. Run the setup wizard and choose your restaurant type to import the demo menu, or skip it and use your own products.
  3. Enter your restaurant name, address and opening hours.
  4. Choose delivery and pickup options, the delivery fee and the minimum order.
  5. Open your Menu page and start taking orders.

FoodMaster Pro

FoodMaster Pro adds the tools a busy restaurant needs:

  • More menu layouts: side menu, sticky category tabs and card product layouts
  • Scheduled orders: customers pick a delivery or pickup date and time
  • Distance-based delivery: delivery zones, distance limits and distance-based fees
  • Dine-in and QR table ordering
  • Multiple locations: several restaurants, each with its own hours and settings
  • Kitchen display and automatic order printing
  • Accept or decline orders and order management panels
  • Delivery driver assignment and SMS notifications
  • Holidays, allergen labels, daily dishes, and deals and combos
  • Statistics and reports, REST API and settings export/import
  • Priority support

See FoodMaster Pro

Documentation and support

  • Free support: the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin
  • Pro support: priority support for Pro customers

FoodMaster is a product of WPSlash. WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc. This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Automattic.

External services

Google Maps embed (Location and hours block)

The “Location and hours” block can show a map of your store. The map is off by default; you turn it on per block with the “Google Map” toggle in the block settings. No API key is needed.

  • What it is used for: showing your store’s location on a map inside the block.
  • What data is sent and when: when a page with the map turned on is viewed, the visitor’s browser loads the map from google.com and sends the store address (as the map search query), along with the visitor’s IP address and browser details. Nothing is sent while the map is off.
  • Service provider: Google LLC. Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms · Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

The block’s optional “Get directions” link opens Google Maps with the store address only when a visitor clicks it.

Google Maps Platform APIs (optional, your own API key)

This plugin can optionally use Google Maps Platform APIs when you enter your own Google API key in the plugin settings.

What it is used for
* Maps JavaScript API — address autocomplete on checkout and admin location fields
* Geocoding API — converting store or customer addresses to coordinates
* Distance Matrix API — calculating delivery distance for delivery fees and restrictions

What data is sent and when
* Store address, customer address, or address typed into autocomplete fields is sent to Google when those features are enabled and configured with an API key
* Data is sent only when a user or administrator uses a feature that requires geocoding, distance calculation, or address suggestions

Google Maps Platform
* Terms: https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms
* Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Third-party libraries

FoodMaster bundles these open-source libraries. Their full copyright and license notices are in the plugin’s licenses/ folder and at the top of each bundled file.

  • Toastify JS 1.12.0 – Copyright (c) 2018 apvarun – MIT License – https://github.com/apvarun/toastify-js (js/toastify.js, css/toastify.css)
  • flatpickr 4.6.13 – Copyright (c) 2017 Gregory Petrosyan – MIT License – https://github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr (js/flatpickr.min.js, css/flatpickr.min.css)
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for FoodMaster Lite.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate. WooCommerce must be installed and active; WordPress shows a link to install it if it’s missing.
  4. Follow the setup wizard.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file, click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Follow the setup wizard.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

You can reopen the wizard at any time from FoodMaster → Setup Wizard. All settings live under FoodMaster in the admin menu.
sections.faq:
Is FoodMaster Lite free?

Yes. FoodMaster Lite is free, and there are no fees or commission on your orders. FoodMaster Pro is an optional paid upgrade with more features.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. FoodMaster Lite is built on WooCommerce, which is free. Products, orders, payments, taxes and emails all stay in WooCommerce.

How do I add the food menu to a page?

Add the Accordion menu block to any page in the block editor. If you import a demo in the setup wizard, a Menu page with the block is created for you.

Can customers choose between delivery and pickup?

Yes. Turn on delivery, pickup or both. Customers choose at checkout, and you set which one is selected by default.

Can I stop orders when the restaurant is closed?

Yes. Set your opening hours for delivery and pickup under FoodMaster → Hours, with several time slots per day if you close between lunch and dinner. You can also pause delivery or pickup at any time from the settings.

How do I add toppings, sizes or other extras?

Go to FoodMaster → Extras and create a group, for example “Toppings” or “Size”. Add its options with prices, choose whether customers pick one or several, and assign the group to product categories or single products.

Can I charge a delivery fee or set a minimum order?

Yes. FoodMaster Lite has a fixed delivery fee and a minimum order amount. Distance-based delivery fees are part of FoodMaster Pro.

Does it work with the WooCommerce block checkout?

Yes. FoodMaster Lite works with the Cart and Checkout blocks and with the classic checkout, and it’s compatible with HPOS.

Which payment methods can I use?

Any WooCommerce payment method: cash on delivery, card payments through Stripe or PayPal, bank transfer and more.

Does it work with my theme?

FoodMaster Lite works with any well-coded theme, including block themes like Twenty Twenty-Five. The menu and blocks use their own styling, which you can adjust in FoodMaster → Settings → Design.

Can I use it for several restaurant locations?

FoodMaster Lite is for one location. Multiple locations, each with their own hours and settings, are part of FoodMaster Pro.

Will I lose my settings if I upgrade to Pro?

No. FoodMaster Pro uses the same settings, products and extras, and adds its features on top.

Is FoodMaster Lite translation-ready?

Yes. All text can be translated, and right-to-left languages are supported.
